Method of Attack: Allows crooks to connect a keyboard to ATMs to access ATM software and control cash dispensing via command-line interface
Requires an 8-digit code valid for 24 hours to activate
Targets ATMs running Windows 10, 8, 7, and XP
Can be used to send commands via function keys to dispense cash
Impacted Systems: ATMs built on the Kalignite Platform (used by 40 ATM vendors in 80 countries)
Attack Vector: Physical access to unsecured ATM ports to connect a keyboard
Use of command-line interface on ATM software
Indicators of Compromise: Malware sample uploaded to VirusTotal in November 2016
